items.title: Mining Machines
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Tired of slow and tedious mining? Then come and drive around in your own mining machines! 
Excavate the land with your Drill, pick up the resources with your Transporter, and more! Combined with your own mining facility, this is the world you've been looking for!

+ 3 industrial machines
+ Mine faster than ever!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Pastel Anime
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Want to stand out? These skins will help! Put on a vibrant outfit, and show off your new bright pastel colored hair.

+ 11 teen skins
+ 1 FREE skin!

items.title: FLEX!
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to show off your awesome new outfit! With jewelry, designer clothing and stylish shoes, your friends are sure to be be jealous of your new look.

+ 11 rich teens in cool clothing
+ 1 FREE skin!

items.title: Fashion Legends
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Endless outfit combinations! Dress to impress as you take on the fashion world! Meet three stunning models, give them makeovers, dress them up, and shine! Can you impress the judges?
* Go shopping at the mall and browse the seemingly endless clothing selections!
* Get to know your models in cutscenes!
* One of Everbloom's most ambitious maps ever!
- SINGLEPLAYER ONLY

items.title: Primal Glitches
items.creator: Team Metallurgy
items.description:
From deep within the Minecraft jungles comes another wave of horrifying glitches! Can you run fast enough and block their ferocious attacks or will they overtake you and drag you back through the rift?

- Includes 14 savage glitch skins!
- When the sky rips open will you stand against them or join them?

items.title: Treehouse City
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Look up into the sky and find not only a treehouse, but a whole city! Customize all the different treehouses with your friends and live together in a giant custom made tree!
- Find loot and other resources in the houses
- Made for version 1.17
- Multiplayer friendly survival spawn

items.title: Mini Cars
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Speed up your survival with these awesome mini cars! Gather resources in your survival and craft the fastest cars to beat your friends on the racing tracks!

- 128 Different craftable cars
- Carwash
- Racing tracks
- Win trophies

items.title: Half Camo
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Tired of the same camouflage skins? Then these skins are for you! Trick your friends with 5 skins that are half human, half camouflage.

- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Nether Creatures
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Don't you think the Nether is scary enough? The most terrifying creatures are here! Be careful players might be a little scared of you.

- 10 Nether themed skins
- 1 free skins
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Mobs In City
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Watch out for mobs camouflaged by street fashion! Perfect for roleplay!

- 12 unique skins
+ 2 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & xfaddy

items.title: Trendy Skyblock Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you like Skyblock? Then you can increase your gaming pleasure with these trendy skins.

- 8 Skyblock themed skins
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Deadly Class
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Gone are the days of fear with this class. Join us and start the adventure.

- 5 ninja themed skins
- By Pixelusion & Rvan Studios

items.title: Skyblock Earth
items.creator: King Cube
items.description:
Skyblock evolved but with a TWIST! Walk AROUND Skyblock Earth and complete intense challenges, battle mobs and SURVIVE in this NEW advanced skyblock experience!

Includes:
+ 24 quests to find!
+ A Mega world to explore
+ And a uniquely fulfilling experience

items.title: Secret Underground Base
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do not judge a book by its cover! What may seem completely normal on the outside may not be on the inside!
Enter an ordinary villager house and surprise yourself!

- Lots of fun for you to experience!
- Live undercover among the villagers!
- Luxurious underground!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Lucky Mobs
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Extreme action and daring thrills await! Lucky Mobs skin pack is sure to bring loads of fun for you and your friends!

- Turn into six incredible and awesome monsters!
- Endless hours of fresh and exciting experiences!
- By Pixelusion & Meraki Studios

items.title: Simply Chess
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Grab your scepter and command your army to checkmate your enemies. Don't worry if you don't know how to play chess. This map includes a tutorial and shows you all of your possible moves in real-time!

- 1+ players!
- Movement tips
- Chess tutorial
- Robert the Robot: an autonomous A.I. opponent to give you a run for your money!
- Three board styles
- Time limit setting

items.title: Popular Teens
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Teens walk among us, and they do it in style.
Are you up for the job? Join us and become one of coolest teens ever!


+ 11 epic teen skins!

items.title: Luxury Planes
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
What do you do when you are a millionaire? You get some luxury planes! Fly around private islands and conquer the skies!

+ 5 luxury planes!
+ 2 private islands!
+ Mansion homes!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Vacation Mode
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Have you ever been in vacation mode? You're sitting in class, or trying to work, when all you can do is daydream of the vacation to come? That's what this skin pack is about; lounging beachside in all of your summer-gear glory. So get your snorkel, floaties, or summer tan on, with this pack of 10 vacation-ready skins.

*1 Free Skin included

items.title: Brilliant Blue
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Check out these cool teens showing off their favorite color, blue! These 6 skins are complete with fashionable designs and styles. Which one is your favorite?

items.title: Cute Mobs
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Become a Cute Mob With This Skin Pack And Surprise Your Friends. 



- Contains 12 Different Cute Mob Skins
- Perfect For Roleplay!

items.title: Soccer Championship
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Become a soccer player with this skin pack.

Stand out from your friends by wearing these brand new skins.
You can choose between 25 soccer-skins. 

- Contains 25 different soccer
- Perfect for roleplay!
- Have fun

items.title: Emoji Party
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Put on your best dress and best face, or just show up as you. Either way, it's time to party! Cry if you want to, laugh if you want to, love if you want to, puke if you want to. You have all the faces to do it here in this massive, emoji-themed, teen skin pack. 20 skins in all!

items.title: K-pop Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs are now k-pop stars and have just made a comeback! Turns heads everywhere you go with the latest mob skins!

- 8 different skins!

This set includes the following:

- Creeper
- Skeleton
- Ghast
- Slime
- Pig
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Spider
